social.text: I've never had any problems with Claude code. When I prompt I usually give it a full pitch of the product, what goal the product needs to achieve, several suggestions on how to implement it, what to avoid and a disclaimer that it can deviate from my instructions if I ever say something contradictory or if theres a better way to achieve the goal. I see some people in this subreddit experiencing fatal problems like getting their whole shit deleted. Since im not an educated actually talented engineer this is the LAST thing I want. So I'd like to see how the community formulates their prompts so…
